## Claude review

**Verdict:** incomplete

I could not complete a trustworthy review of this diff in the time available and must report it as incomplete rather than guess.

What I verified directly myself (read in full): CLAUDE.md, docs/adr/014-child-pr-auto-merge-requires-the-runner-approval-mark.md, docs/adr/025-mcp-tools-are-restate-handlers-and-the-operator-object-is-the-refresh-authority.md, docs/adr/040-admins-reach-the-restate-ui-through-the-orchestrator.md, docs/comment-gapfill-rail.md (new), docs/feature-branch-grouping.md, docs/restate-testing.md, docs/restate.md, docs/review-fix-rail.md, and the two small test diffs src/__tests__/restate/kg-refresh-pilot.restate.test.ts and src/__tests__/restate/kg-refresh-workflow.restate.test.ts (both are mechanical updates adding `restateReady: () => true` to `callToolAsSystem` call sites, consistent with the new AII-1281 admission gate described in docs/restate.md — no issue).

From that direct reading I confirmed one carried-forward minor finding is still unresolved: the stray double blank line in docs/review-fix-rail.md before "## One writer per PR", flagged by both prior Claude reviews on this PR, remains present in the current HEAD's diff against origin/testing.

The remaining 43 changed files — the three large clusters (Restate/operator: late-external-review.ts, operator-legacy-scrub.ts, operator-object.ts, endpoint.ts, ui-proxy.ts, tools-client.ts, review-process.ts, review-head-clean.ts; review-fix/gap-fill: review-fix-production.ts, comment-gapfill-drain.ts, auto-merge.ts, review-ledger.ts, post-push-review.ts; and GitHub/webhook/callback: github.ts, webhook.ts, runner-callback.ts, workflow-probe.ts, log.ts, index.ts — plus all their test files) were delegated to three parallel sub-agents for full-file reads and caller/test tracing, per the task's instruction to read every changed file in full and trace callers and tests across a 53-file, +2716/-282 diff. Those sub-reviews had not returned results before I was required to finalize this output, so I have no verified findings for that majority of the diff — including the two previously-reported items that prior review passes disagreed about (whether `auto-merge.ts`'s redundant `headReviewedClean`/`headHasBlockingFinding` check is still present, and whether the `job.inFlight` "superseded" guard's documentation in late-external-review.ts overstates its protection). I did not carry those forward as findings because I could not re-confirm them against the current code myself, and the task instructions require deriving every finding from the current diff rather than repeating an earlier comment uncritically.

Per the task's own guidance ("An explicit incomplete review is better than an approval that did not look"), I'm marking this incomplete rather than approving or requesting changes without having examined the bulk of the diff.

### Findings

- **[minor]** (docs/review-fix-rail.md:304): The stray double blank line immediately before the "## One writer per PR" heading (flagged by two earlier review passes on this same PR) is still present in the current diff — I confirmed this directly by reading `git diff origin/testing...HEAD -- docs/review-fix-rail.md`, which shows the new AII-1307 section ending with two blank lines (one of them newly added) before the heading. Cosmetic only; carried forward, not newly found.
